entities.name: Red Iron Mountains
entities.description: Mineral-rich mountains on Aerona, Dominaria, east of Benalia, known for red iron ore.

entities.name: Peregrinator Complex
entities.description: Hidden site in the hills where a kobold plot was uncovered.

entities.name: Grover's
entities.description: Hidden waypoint site in the hills.

entities.name: Automatown
entities.description: Settlement of artificers and archaeologists east of Grover's.

entities.name: Alaqua
entities.description: Finest Benalish warlord, lost in the defeat by dwarves.

entities.name: Loot Niptil
entities.description: An amnesiac wizard who aided cat warriors and a dwarf around 4100 AR.

entities.name: Dreadfang
entities.description: Kobold chieftain who fell after a cursed trove.

entities.name: Crookshank Kobolds
entities.description: Native kobolds who fared poorly in the Rift Era.

entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: Benalish leader who used the mountains as a staging ground in 4562 AR.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion whose war machines lie rusting in the mountains.

events.summary: Benalia tries to extend influence into the mountains around 4068 AR and is defeated by dwarven warriors, losing Alaqua.
events.quote: The Benalish were defeated by dwarven warriors

events.summary: Loot Niptil aids allies in uncovering a kobold plot at the Peregrinator Complex, leading to Dreadfang's downfall.
events.quote: led to the downfall of the kobold chieftain Dreadfang

events.summary: Loot is falsely accused of murder in Automatown, exposes the true culprit and defeats a rogue construct.
events.quote: Loot was falsely accused of murder in Automatown

events.summary: Danitha Capashen musters Benalish troops in the mountains before pushing east against the Phyrexians.
events.quote: used as a staging ground by Danitha Capashen and her Benalish troops

relations.quote: located on the continent of Aerona on Dominaria
